policy.durationBasis: published-author-reference; no learner-duration or throughput calibration
policy.ordinaryCompletion: Exact bound original fully answered and correct, or its real errors cleared through existing correction status. Practice assistance/seen allowed; never independent capability certification.
policy.runtimeApplication: Only an unstarted/unfrozen owner day with no attributable records/drafts/exposure. Global seen source does not freeze a future consolidation day. Apply every change to an eligible day atomically, else retain complete base day and report blocked.
policy.composition: expanded-base -> required-public -> adaptive-reference-minutes; original started/frozen day bypasses new overlays

vocabularyCoverage.scope: Located orthographic candidates from the source-acquisition audit; not a fresh mastery/semantic coverage measurement or execution of context links.

supplementalSourceAudit.scope: New GSA anchors are not added to the older orthographic audit counts. Signed sense approval is not enrollment or learner evidence.

limitations: Author reference durations plus default Pomodoro rest are capacity assumptions, not measured learner throughput. Actual due reviews, errors and slower work consume the same 360 minutes and must carry unfinished required work forward.
Calendar level is a planned practice ceiling, not evidence of capability. Runtime must preserve actual placement/prerequisite guards; C1 input is not forced on an A1 learner.
Context word links are dictionary/word-form candidates. Meaning must be checked against the sentence; no claim that 8000 senses were taught or mastered.

Preserved earlier core occurrence is a static guard. Runtime replacement additionally requires reliable ordinary completion; otherwise verified append fallback or complete base-day retention with visible blocked assignment.
Fixed review windows are planning prompts. Actual memory due and valid learning evidence override them; no new cards or mastery evidence are created by this blueprint.
Source-linked R/L consolidations share exposure and ordinary question memory; they are never independent assessment or unseen-transfer evidence.

optimization.objective: First maximize actual assigned variants, then review windows, current word/grammar matches, safe repeated-core replacements and earliest delivery. No difficulty/budget/spacing constraint is relaxed.
